The reason why we repent today is because we have been patient since time immemorial, still in the ordinary world's position of no matter how high or low, our sins are immeasurable: either because of the three karmas that cause sins, or because of internal delusions, or because of deluded external circumstances, giving rise to preoccupation.

Thus, ten bad karma result, eighty-four thousand sins. Although these sins are immeasurable, they include three things: afflictions, karma, and retribution. These three evil dharmas are dharmas that hinder the Holy Path and prevent good retributions for humans and heaven. That's why the Sutras call it the three hindrances, so the Buddhas and Bodhisattva teach the methods of repentance and elimination. When those three hindrances are eliminated, the six senses, ten evils, and up to eighty-four thousand senses are all pure.

Today we are called... with all our hearts and minds to overcome the three hindrances. If you want to eliminate the three hindrances, you must use these thoughts: First, you must develop the seven superior minds as a means, then eliminate them: One is the mind of shame; second is the mind of fear; Third, the mind is bored with distance; four is Bodhi mind; Fifth, the mind and body are equal; Sixth, the mind thinks of repaying Buddha's gratitude; Seventh, the mind contemplates the inherently empty nature of sin.

The first feeling of shame is to think that we and Buddha Shakyamuni are the same ordinary people, but the World-Honored One has attained enlightenment and has gone through as many lives as dust, and we are still infatuated with the six worlds together, drifting in the cycle of birth and death, never knowing when to escape. Like that, it's truly shameful, the most shameful in the world.

Second, the mind is afraid. As ordinary people, their body, speech, and mind karma often consent to sin. Because of that cause, after death, one must fall into hell, hungry ghosts, and animals and suffer endlessly. Like that, it's really scary and scary.

Third, the mind of distant boredom is that we often contemplate together in the path of birth and death, only impermanence, suffering, emptiness, no-self, impurity, falseness, like floating water bubbles, melting and spinning back and forth like rolling wheels; In addition, birth, old age, illness, death, eight sufferings burn without stopping. We look right in the body, from head to toe there are thirty-six things: hair, feathers, teeth, nails, mucus, tears, snot, saliva, dandruff, sweat, defecation, urination, stomach, thin skin, blood, flesh, tendons, veins, bones, marrow, fish fat, water fat, brain, membrane, spleen, kidneys, heart, lungs, liver, bile, intestines, stomach, red phlegm, white phlegm, reproductive organs, mature organs, often excreted. out nine holes. So in the Sutra it is said: "This body is a container for suffering, full of impurities, so it is not loved by wise people." In the cycle of birth and death, there are such bad things, it's really worrying and boring!

Fourth, develop Bodhi mind. The sutras say: "One should desire the Buddha body, because the Buddha body is the Dharma body. That Dharma body is born from countless intellectual merits, born from love, compassion, joy, and equanimity, born from practicing the thirty-seven dharmas supporting Bodhi. Because of those intellectual merits, the Tathagata body is born. If you want to have that body, you must develop the mind of Bodhi, pray for All-Strain Wisdom, Permanence, Bliss, Self, Purity, attain the state of Sattva, pure Buddhahood. to save and achieve sentient beings without sparing themselves, their lives, or their property."

Fifth, the mind of resentment and equality is towards all sentient beings, opening a compassionate heart without distinction of "self". Because if you still see "resentful" people different from "close" people, then there is still discrimination. Because there is discrimination, there is attachment, because there is attachment, afflictions arise, because afflictions arise, evil karma is created, because evil karma is created, evil karma is created.

Sixth, the mind thinks of thanking Buddha. The Tathagata, for our sake, has given up his head, eyes, marrow, brain, limbs, flesh and bones, country, wife, children, elephants, horses, seven treasures, for countless eons, to practice asceticism. That grace, that virtue is difficult to repay. Therefore, the Sutra says: "Even if we carry our burdens on our shoulders and go through a number of eons like endless sands, it would still be difficult to repay the Buddha's gratitude. We want to repay the Tathagata's gratitude. In this life, we must be brave and diligent in enduring hardships, not sparing our lives to build the Three Jewels, propagate the Mahayana teachings, save sentient beings, and attain perfect enlightenment."

Seventh, the mind contemplates the nature of sin that is not real, is the sin that has no self-nature, is born due to causes and conditions, is created by madness, and is born due to causes and conditions, it is also destroyed due to causes and conditions. The cause of sin is being close to evil friends, causing immense karma. The cause and effect of eliminating sins means today purifying the mind and repenting. Therefore, the Sutra teaches: "Sin nature is not inside, not outside, not in the middle. You should know that sin nature is inherently empty.

Having created the seven types of mind as above, then think of the Buddhas of the ten directions, along with the Sages, respectfully clasp your hands, expose your heart, express your supplication, and shamefully repent. Repenting like that, no sin will not be destroyed, no blessing will be born. If you don't repent wholeheartedly, if you keep procrastinating lazily and letting your emotions wander, it will only be painful for you, and will not benefit you at all. Besides, human life is as impermanent as spinning a torch. When the exhaled breath does not return, this body is like ash on the ground, the sufferings of the three paths must be borne by oneself, one cannot rely on money or treasure to escape, one remains forever in darkness with no grace period, one suffers alone, with no one to replace it.

Don't think that in this life we ​​don't commit crimes, but don't consider ourselves in need of repentance, because in the Sutra it says: "Every time a mortal man moves his foot or takes a step, he commits a sin." In past lives, many bad karmas have been committed, unspeakable, and they often follow us like a shadow follows a shape. If you don't repent, your crimes will become deeper and deeper. You should know that if you hide your sins, Buddha will not tolerate them; Revealed to repent, Mr. Tinh Danh respected him. Therefore, we should know that sentient beings are forever immersed in the ocean of suffering due to the habit of hiding their sins. Therefore, today we would like to reveal our repentance openly, not daring to hide it.

Three obstacles: one is affliction, two is karma, three is retribution. These three types of hindrances cause each other, such as because of afflictions, evil karma is born, and because of evil karma, one must suffer suffering. Therefore, today we wholeheartedly repent.

First, repent of your karmic afflictions, because those afflictions are all caused by your mind. And when the mind karma arises, the body karma and speech karma follow. Karma has greed, anger, and ignorance. Because of ignorance, wrong views arise and cause many evil deeds. Therefore, the Sutra says: "The three karmas of greed, anger, and ignorance cause sentient beings to fall into three realms: hell, hungry ghosts, and animals, suffering endlessly. If one becomes a human, one must also suffer the evil consequences of afflictions: poverty, neediness, orphanage, plus aggressiveness, stubbornness, stupidity, and not knowing right or wrong."

Our will karma has caused so many evil results, so today we dedicate our whole lives and lives to the Buddhas, praying for repentance.

The Buddhas, Bodhisattva, and saints have clearly understood the truth of these afflictions and have all rebuked them. This affliction is called injustice, because affliction destroys the wisdom base and life of sentient beings; also call this affliction a robber, because it robs sentient beings of good dharmas; This affliction is also called a strong waterfall, because it attracts living beings into the ocean of suffering of birth and death; This affliction is also called a chain, because it binds sentient beings to the prison of birth and death from which they can never escape, having to wander forever in the six realms and four species, causing infinite evil karma and suffering endlessly. Only then do we know that these misfortunes are caused by afflictions. So today, the monk's heart prays for repentance.

The Dharma of Repentance is to correct past mistakes, eliminate evil and do good. Everyone in the world is not at fault, like a learned person who misses mindfulness and suffers from afflictions. An Arhat, when concentration arises, also commits karma of body, speech, and mind, not to mention how can ordinary people avoid sin. Those who are wise and know in advance immediately repent and change their mistakes, but the foolish ones hide them, so their sins become more abundant, accumulating for a long time, not knowing when they will be enlightened. If you know how to be ashamed and confess, you will not only destroy your sins, but also add immeasurable merit and build the marvelous Nirvana of the Tathagata.

To practice the method of Repentance, first of all, the body must be solemn and neat, admiring the statue, the mind must be respectful, follow the method of visualization, wholeheartedly pray, and think about two things: First, think that the body and life are difficult to maintain, once broken, it is impossible to know when it will be restored. If you don't meet the Buddhas and the Sages, if you encounter evil friends, create more karma, you will fall into a deep, dangerous place. Second, we must think to ourselves, today although we meet the Tathagata's Dharma, we do not know that because the Buddha Dharma follows the Holy lineage, it purifies the three karma of body, speech, and mind, to behave according to good dharma, but specifically does evil deeds, intentionally covering it up; say that others don't know, others don't see, hide it in their hearts, openly and without shame. That is truly a very stupid thing in the world.

The Buddhas of the ten directions, the Bodhisattvas and the good gods, always use their pure Divine Eye to see all the crimes we commit.

Furthermore, the gods in the dark places record their sins and blessings without any mistake. Speaking of people who have committed crimes, after death, their souls are captured by the bull-headed prison and placed in front of the King of Hell at night to examine right and wrong. At that time, all the unjust people who were testifying said: "You previously butchered me, killed me, cooked, stewed, roasted, grilled me...", or said: "Before, you robbed me and took all my money, separated my relatives, today I have the opportunity to be in front of you to give clear evidence, no longer hiding it and only having to accept my previous sins."

In the Sutra it is clearly stated: In hell there will never be a wrongful death. Whatever crimes a person commits on a daily basis, even though they have forgotten them, when they die, all those appearances created by previous evil karma appear, saying: "In the past, you were with me and committed such crimes, how can you hide them now?" At that time, sinners have nowhere to hide. At that moment, the King of Hell gritted his teeth and rebuked him and sent him to hell, where he could not escape for countless eons. That is not strange and has nothing to do with others. It is your own creation that you have to suffer. Even if you are as close as a father and son, once the retribution confronts them, they cannot replace each other.

So now we can have a healthy body without illness, so we should try our best to practice and compete for longevity. When great tribulation occurs, we won't have time to repent. Therefore, we wholeheartedly pray for repentance.

Karma enriches all paths, wherever one is immersed, one refuses to think and seek liberation. Therefore, the retribution in the six paths is not the same, the shape of each species is different. Only then did we know that it was caused by karma. Among Buddha's ten powers, karma is the deepest.

Most ordinary people often have doubts. Because we see that in life, people who do good encounter many difficulties, and people who do evil experience peace and harmony, so we think that there is no distinction between good and evil. People accept this because they do not understand the profound principles of karma. The scriptures say there are three types of karma:

One is present retribution, two is birth retribution, three is post retribution. Retribution means that in this life, if good or evil deeds are done, this body will receive retribution. Retribution means doing good and evil deeds in this life, only to receive retribution in the next life. Retribution means doing good and evil deeds in countless lifetimes in the past, only in this life or countless lifetimes later will we receive retribution.

At that time, the person who did evil had good luck because the good karma had resulted in retribution and the consequences had been matured in the past life, so he could enjoy good results. So it is not true that doing evil in this life will result in good retribution. Those who do good things now are suffering, because evil karma has resulted in retribution and consequences that have matured in past lives, so today's good seeds are weak and cannot stop those evil karma, so they have to suffer. It's not like in this life, if you do good, you will receive evil in return.

Seeing that in life people who do good things are praised and respected by others, they know that in the future they will surely enjoy happy results. We have had such bad karma in the past, so the Buddhas and Bodhisattva taught us to be close to good friends and practice repentance together. We have already repented of the three evil karmas of the body, now we would like to follow the steps of repenting of the four karmas of the mouth.

In the Sutra, it is said: "The sins committed by the mouth often cause sentient beings to fall into hell, and hungry ghosts suffer endlessly. If reincarnated as an animal, one must become an Owl or a Cat bird, with an obnoxious cry. If one is born as a human, one's mouth will stink, no one will believe what one says, and among relatives there will often be discord and fights and arguments. The karma of the mouth has such evil results, so today we sincerely take refuge in the Three Jewels and pray to Sam regret.

We... from beginningless time until now, because of our bad speech karma, we have had to stay in the four realms and six species, commit many sins, speak harshly, use cruel and insolent words, do not know how to be respectful, treat those close to us, the noble and the lowly, slightly against our will, and get angry and scold us. Scolding and humiliating many vile, evil and cruel things, leaving nothing behind, causing others to hold a grudge for the rest of their lives and not forget, causing harm and making enemies that will never end, even complaining about heaven and earth, blaming ghosts and gods, disparaging the Sages, slandering and humiliating good people. The karma caused by such evil speech is immeasurable and boundless. Today we all sincerely repent.

From beginningless time until now, because of the karma of lying, many sins have been created: In the desire for honor and gain, to hide true feelings, to lie about all sorts of things, in the heart to be confused, to be bold on the outside, to say no about things, to say yes about not; If you see, say you don't see, if you don't see, say you see; hear and say don't listen, don't hear and say listen; know how to say don't know, don't know how to say know; do say don't do, don't do say do; When you defame the Sages, deceive people, like father and son, kings and servants, relatives, and friends, you are never truthful in what you say, causing others to mishear you, to the point of losing your home and country. He also pretends to be a sorcerer who often praises himself, boasting that he has attained the level of the Four Meditations, the four Formless Samadhis, An-na-batna, the sixteen contemplative practices, the Sotapanna level, the Arhat level, the Pratyekabuddha, the Bodhisattva Non-regression and the heavenly dragons, demons, wind gods, and earth gods all come to him, and perform strange tricks to fascinate people's hearts in order to respectfully offer the four necessary items. The karma caused by false speech is immeasurable and boundless. Today we all sincerely repent.

Since time immemorial, the karma of embellished speech has created many sins: using flowery words, glossy literature, distorting mistakes, embellishing wrong things, cleverly placing songs, imagining loveliness, describing lustful habits, causing the middle and lower classes to become absent-minded and intoxicated with alcohol, unable to self-discipline. Or indulge in personal hatred, regardless of righteous opinions, whether the other person is a loyal minister, a filial son or a wise man, a sage, still writes and embellishes the crime, so that later generations will believe it to be true, causing that person to hold on to hatred under the nine election, not knowing where to explain it.

The sins caused by such reliance are immeasurable and boundless. Today we all sincerely repent.

Since time immemorial, because of the karma of double-tongued speech, many sins have been caused: praising to one's face and criticizing behind one's back, being deceitful in all directions, going to that person to talk about this person, going to this person to talk about that person, only knowing their own interests, not looking at the harm of others, slandering to separate my king, slandering and humiliating honest people, causing my king to doubt each other, father and son to be at odds with each other, causing husband and wife to leave each other, relatives to separate from each other, disgracing teachers and students, causing them to stop coming and going. friends, even came to make the two countries that were on good terms with each other have to cancel their alliance, lose peace, cause hatred, bring soldiers to fight each other, and kill hundreds of people. The karma of double-tongued speech causes such immeasurable and boundless sins. Today, we sincerely turn to the Buddhas, the Dharma, and the Saints in the ten directions to confess to those who seek repentance.

I pray that through the merit of repenting the four evil karmas of speech, I will be able to have the full eight sounds and four eloquence skills, often speak words that harmonize with benefits, have an elegant voice that everyone wants to hear, and be able to clearly understand the language of living beings. If anything is said, it will be appropriate to one's base, causing anyone who hears to gain enlightenment, enter the sublime Sainthood, and open the eyes of wisdom.

Repent and make a vow, then dedicate your entire life to pay homage to the Three Jewels.

Having previously repented of the three evil karmas of the body and the four evil karmas of the mouth, I now ask forgiveness for the sins caused by the six senses.

We... from beginningless time until now, our eyes are fascinated by the shapes and colors outside, craving the colors black, yellow, purple, blue, along with precious toys and jewelry; or seeing the appearance of men, women, tall, short, white, black, beautiful and graceful gestures, which gives rise to illegal thoughts; or ears that crave listening to beautiful sounds such as: bow, spear, lute, flute, singing, rhyming, or listening to elegant voices, speech, cries and laughter of men and women, which gives rise to illegal thoughts; or the nose likes the scent of Agarwood, Sandalwood, Camphor, Musk or the scent of Uat Kim tree, To Hop tree which gives rise to illegal thoughts; Or the tongue craves to taste delicious, lush, sweet and fatty flavors, so it must use the flesh and blood of living beings to nourish the body of the four great elements, cultivate more roots of suffering, and give rise to illegal thoughts; Or the body craves flashiness, brocade, fabric, silk, all things soft and beautiful, with beautiful and precious clothes, which gives rise to illegal thoughts; Or your mind is often disordered, so wherever you encounter it, it is against the law. Because the six senses create such immeasurable and boundless karma, today we sincerely turn to the Buddhas, the Dharma, and the Saints in the ten directions to repent.

Through the merit of Repenting of sins caused by the eye faculty, we pray that this eye sees throughout the pure Dharma body of the Buddhas of the ten directions, Bodhisattva, without differences.

Thanks to the merit of Repenting for sins caused by the ear faculty, we pray that this ear will often hear the Dharma spoken by the Buddhas and Sages of the ten directions, and practice according to that Dharma.

Thanks to the merit of Repenting for the sins caused by our senses, we pray that this nose will always smell the fragrance of entering the Dharma nature in the Fragrance Tich world, far away from the impure stench of birth and death.

Through the merit of repenting of sins caused by the tongue, we vow that this tongue will often eat the food of Zen and the Dharma, not coveting the flesh and blood of living beings.

Thanks to the merit of Repenting of sins committed by the body, we vow that this body can wear the "Tathagata's clothes", the "armor of Patience", lie on the "bed without fear", sit on the "empty Dharma seat".

Thanks to the merit of Repenting of sins caused by the mind, we make this wish to achieve the ten powers, to understand the five wisdoms, to clearly examine the truth of the equality of the two truths, to follow wisdom and expedient means, to enter the stream of Dharma nature of clear mindfulness, and to reveal the Tathagata's dharma of non-birth and patience.

Having made my vow, I would like to dedicate my whole life to pay homage to the Three Jewels.

noi_dung:
COMPASSIONATE WATER REPENTANCE

(FINAL VOLUME)

All Buddhas, out of compassion for sentient beings, speak the Water Repentance Ashram Dharma. Today we dedicate our entire lives to all Buddhas.

Namo Vairocana Buddha.
Namo Master Shakyamuni Buddha.
Namo Amitabha Buddha.
Namo Maitreya Buddha.
Namo Dragon Race Supreme King Buddha.
Namo Dragon King Buddha.
Namo Bao Thang Buddha.
Namo Giac Hoa Dinh Tu Tu King Buddha.
Namo Ca Sa Trang Buddha.
Namo Lion Roaring Buddha.
Namo Manjushri Bodhisattva.
Namo Samantabhadra Bodhisattva.
Namo Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva.
Namo Kshitigarbha Bodhisattva.
Namo Great Dignity Bodhisattva.
Namo Bodhisattva Monastery.

Pay homage to the Buddhas and then repent. Up there, he repented of three karmas of the body and four karmas of the mouth. Now we repent of all karma towards Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha.

In the Buddhist scriptures, it is taught: "The human body is difficult to obtain, the Buddha Dharma is difficult to hear, the Sangha is difficult to meet, faith is difficult to be born, the six senses are difficult to satisfy, good friends are difficult to meet." Today, thanks to our past lives, we have created many good roots, so we can have a human body with six full senses, meet good friends, and hear the Dharma. If at this time, you do not practice diligently, you will surely be immersed in thousands of sufferings, not knowing when you will escape. Therefore, today, I sincerely pray for repentance.

We... from beginningless time until now have often suffered from ignorance that obscures our minds, afflictions that block our consciousness, when we see Buddha images we do not wholeheartedly respect them, despise the Sangha, harm our good friends, destroy stupas, destroy pagodas, burn Buddhist statues, and harm the Buddha's body; Or if we live in a nice house, we put the Buddha and Bodhisattva statues in a low and dirty place, the smoke is hot from the sun, the wind blows and the rain blows, the dust is all over us, birds and mice are chiseling away; or worship together in the bedroom without ever paying homage or being naked in front of the Buddha statue, without dressing properly and solemnly; Or cover up the lights and torches, close the temple doors, and obscure the Buddha's light. For such sins, today we all sincerely repent.

Since beginningless time until now, when dealing with the Buddha's Dharma, people have held sutras with dirty hands, or while reading and reciting, they have mixed in illegal profanity; or leave the Sutra on the head of the bed, sit or stand without respect; Or put it in a chest where worms will eat it; Or roll it up, causing the book to fall out and get mixed up in order and type; Or you drag it, break it, tear the paper and lose the words, you don't practice it yourself, you don't want to pass it on. For such sins, today we all ask for repentance.

Lie down and listen to the Sutras, lie down on your back and recite them, or talk and laugh loudly, disturbing others to listen to the Dharma; or misinterpreting Buddha's teachings, saying something different from the Holy Will, not the Dharma saying the Dharma, it is the Dharma saying not the Dharma; If you have not committed a crime, say it is a violation, if you have committed a crime, say you have not committed it, if you commit a light crime, say it is serious, if you commit a serious crime, say it is light; or copy the previous paragraph of the Bible and put it in the next paragraph, the next paragraph and put it in the previous paragraph, or the previous paragraph and the next paragraph and put it in the middle, or the middle paragraph and put it front and back; or embroider words from Buddhist scriptures to make your own books; or for the sake of honor and respect, to speak Dharma; not interested in the Dharma, just because they want to find the fault of the Dharma Master, they discuss the meaning; Not for the sake of improving understanding to seek the dharma of the world, but just absurdly criticizing Buddha's words, respecting heretical teachings, criticizing Mahayana, praising Thanh Van. Such sins are immeasurable and boundless, today we all ask for repentance.

From beginningless time until now, the Sangha has caused karmic obstacles to the Sangha, such as killing Arhats, disrupting the harmony of the Sangha, harming those who have developed the mind of Supreme Bodhi, completely stopping being like the Buddha, making the Holy Path unable to circulate; or strip practitioners, interrogate monks, beat them, torture them, and scold them with harsh words; or breaking pure precepts and losing all dignity; or advise others to abandon the Noble Eightfold Path; or keep and practice the five evil spells; or impersonating a monk and stealing from Thuong Tru to spend on personal matters. For such sins, today we all ask for repentance.

Or let yourself be naked or wear thin clothes and suddenly come before the Sutra; or wear dirty shoes to enter the Buddha's temple and step on the Buddha's tower; or wearing clogs into the temple, spitting phlegm in the meditation house, making the place where the Buddha and the Sangha live dirty; or ride a horse or cart and rush into temples and monasteries. Whenever such sins arise against the Three Jewels, they are immeasurable and boundless. Today we sincerely turn to the Buddhas, the Dharma, and the Saints in the ten directions to pray for repentance.

May thanks to that merit of Repentance, we will often encounter the Three Jewels to revere and revere, never to be discouraged, and have fine silk brocades, precious happiness, hundreds of thousands of music, famous dishes, delicious fruits, and all the worldly possessions to make offerings. If anyone becomes a Buddha, we vow to come first and invite them to open the nectar door to save sentient beings. If any Buddha enters Nirvana, we vow to make one last offering. As for the Sangha, we vow to practice the six dharmas of harmony and respect, gain the strength to be free, revive the Three Jewels, propagate Buddhism above, and below save sentient beings.

The sins that are either serious or light against the Three Jewels have been repented of, and for the remaining crimes, we would like to repent according to the class of repentance. As the Sutra says: "There are two types of people who are strong: One is not committing a sin; the other is having committed a sin but knows how to repent." There are two pure methods that can help sentient beings eliminate obstacles: one is to know shame so one does not do evil, the other is to know shame so one does not incite others to do evil. Only with such shame can we be called human. If you don't know shame, you're no different from an animal. Therefore, today we sincerely take refuge in the Buddha and repent according to the Dharma.

From time immemorial until now, because of superstitious and wrong views, people have been killing living beings to worship ghosts and gods. or lie about seeing the devil, then pretend to be a god to deceive people. For such sins, today we all ask for repentance.

From time immemorial until now, either they act insolently, are arrogant, or rely on the nobility to bully everyone, rely on their luxury to despise the cowardly, or rely on their strength to bully the weak, or drink alcohol and cause chaos regardless of their relatives, and stay drunk all day without knowing the hierarchy. We all ask for repentance for such sins today.

It's like being greedy for food and drink without moderation, eating meat salad, fish salad, or eating the five pungent and foul-smelling things that pollute the Sutras, driving away those who practice and keep the precepts pure; Let loose your thoughts, stay away from good people, stay close to evil friends. For such sins, today we all ask for repentance.

They also have a high dedication, telling lies, forcing others to follow their example, stubbornly insisting on being good, stubbornly defying people, not knowing the situation, thinking themselves to be right, others to be wrong, and often hoping for luck. For such sins, today we all ask for repentance.

When it comes to money, he doesn't yield or is shameless; Buying and selling alcohol and deceitful meat to live, or lending money at high prices, counting each day and hour to contribute harshly, never getting tired of greed; enjoy offerings without shame; or not being virtuous but misusing alms. For such sins, today we all ask for repentance.

And beat servants, and order children to do hard work regardless of their hunger, thirst, cold, or heat; Destroying bridges and culverts hinders travel. For such sins, today we all ask for repentance.

Let your thoughts run wild, just spend time gambling, playing Chinese chess, or gathering together to drink, eat, eat, drink, eat, drink, and make trouble for each other; talking aimlessly, or discussing people's affairs, year after year, letting the days and hours pass without any benefit; Every night three times without chanting sutras and meditating, lazily relaxing and lying all day without paying attention to the six pieces of Remembrance and seeing others doing things better than you, you will become jealous, embrace malice, create all kinds of afflictions, let the whirlwind of desires blow into the wood of the fire of sin, burning endlessly, burning away the small good things of the three karmas. When the good dharmas are exhausted, it turns out that one will fall into the great hell, with no time to get out. That's why today, we bow our heads towards the Three Jewels of the ten directions and ask for repentance for all.

All the sins up to now, whether light or heavy, gross or subtle, whether we did it ourselves, or told others to do it, or saw others doing it for joy, or used force to force others to do it, even the sins of praising those who did evil, today we sincerely ask for repentance.

I pray that through the merit of repenting of these crimes, we will be merciful, filial, humble, patient, know how to be honest, know how to greet first, correct ourselves, be pure and benevolent, be tolerant, stay away from evil friends, often encounter good relationships, gain the six faculties, preserve the three karma, be patient with hardships, not retreat in our mind, keep determined to practice and attain enlightenment, and not be ungrateful to sentient beings.

Make a vow and then pay homage to the Buddhas with all your life.

Namo Vairocana Buddha.
Namo Master Shakyamuni Buddha.
Namo Amitabha Buddha.
Namo Maitreya Buddha.
Namo Dragon Race Supreme King Buddha.
Namo Dragon King Buddha.
Namo Bao Thang Buddha.
Namo Giac Hoa Dinh Tu Tu King Buddha.
Namo Ca Sa Trang Buddha.
Namo Lion Roaring Buddha.
Namo Manjushri Bodhisattva.
Namo Samantabhadra Bodhisattva.
Namo Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva.
Namo Kshitigarbha Bodhisattva.
Namo Great Dignity Bodhisattva.
Namo Bodhisattva Monastery.

Previously, I had repented of my afflictions and karmic obstacles. Now, in order to explain the remaining karmic consequences, please repent of all of them.

In the Sutra it is said: "When karma has come, not in the air, in the sea, in mountain caves, there is no place to escape retribution, only the power of Repentance can eliminate it." Why do you know? Because like Mr. Thich De Hoan Nhon, when he saw the five signs of decline appearing, he was terrified and sincerely took refuge in the Three Jewels. Those five bad signs were immediately destroyed and his life span was extended. There are many such stories in the Bible, not the same. Only then will we know that Repentance can eliminate disasters.

However, if ordinary people do not meet a good friend to guide them, there will be no evil deed they do not do, so much so that when they are about to die, the hideous scene of hell appears before their eyes, and at that moment they regret and fear. Oh! If you don't practice good deeds in the past to repent on the day, how can you repent in time? Blessings or disasters were sown by oneself in the past, now one goes straight to hell, one goes alone, to be rolled into a cauldron of boiling oil, body and mind broken, spirit in agony. At that time, even if you want to bow or repent, it will not be easy anymore.

Therefore, everyone should not rely on their youth, strength, money, and influence to be lazy and indulge in self-indulgence. Once the suffering of death has come, regardless of old, young, poor, rich, rich, or poor, all demons will disappear. Impermanent ghosts come suddenly without letting anyone know in advance. Human life is as impermanent as morning dew drops. Even though an exhaled breath is there, the inhaled breath is uncertain.

So, why don't you repent? If the messenger of the Five Heavens or a Rakshasa demon suddenly comes, no matter how strong the youth is, it cannot be avoided. At that time, even if you had a beautiful house with a high floor, it would not be of any use to you. You could not bring a good car or horse with you, your wife and children would no longer be your relatives, and your precious furniture would only be for others to enjoy. With that said, retribution in life is fake and not real. As for heaven, although it is really fun, it will eventually be ruined. When life is over, one must still fall into the three realms. That's why the Buddha told Tu-datta: "Your teacher is a clear-minded Uat-to-lam-phat-loi. He has conquered afflictions and has reached the heaven of Phi-phi-idea, but when he dies, he will still have to fall into the animal world as a child of Phi-ly, let alone other people." That's how we know that as long as we don't reach Sainthood, we will still be rotated through evil paths. If you're not careful, one day you'll suddenly end up in that place, you'll really regret it! It seems like today, when a person is convicted of a crime and has to go to the public door, it is a small suffering, but his heart is filled with fear, and his relatives are terrified and ask for help from all sides. The suffering in hell is a hundred thousand times greater, incomparable.

We have spent countless lives together, our sins piled up like Mount Tu-di. Hearing that, how can we be at peace without fear or horror, only to have to suffer those sufferings later? How painful! Therefore, today we sincerely pray for repentance. From beginningless time until now, we... have had many karmic retributions, but the heaviest is only Avici hell. As clearly stated in the Sutra, now let me briefly talk about the appearance of Avici hell.

Surrounding the prison are seven layers of iron walls, seven times iron nets are placed above, below are seven rows of iron knives as thick as a forest and countless iron-beaked birds, flapping their wings and flying up to peck and carve out the flesh of sinners. The demon has a buffalo head shaped like a La Sat, has nine tails like an iron trident, and nine heads, on its head are eighteen horns, each horn has sixty-four eyes, from each eye secretes heat that burns sinners. Whenever they are angry, they scream like thunder. There are countless knife wheels, spinning down from the air, swirling into the top of the sinner's head, then spinning all the way down to the feet and out. The sinner is in pain to the bone and marrow, aching to the heart and liver, going on like that for countless years, unable to pray for life, unable to pray for death. For such crimes, today we are ashamed and bow our heads to pray for repentance.

Next, we would like to repent for our retribution: our heads and bodies fell apart in the hell of knives and swords, and were burned in the hell of oil cauldrons and braziers; Repent for your sins and burn in hell with iron beds and bronze pillars; Repent for the sins of being crushed in hell by knives and trains; Repent for the sins committed in hell, pull the tongue to let the buffalo plow; Repenting for retributions that cause the internal organs to burn in hell, swallowing hot iron balls and drinking boiling copper water; Repent for your sins, your bones and flesh will be crushed in the iron pillar hell; Repent for your sins and your skin, flesh, bones, and marrow will fall to pieces in hell wrapped in hot iron wire; Repenting for his sins, he was tormented and suffocated in the hell of a river of ash; Repent for the sins of freezing and cracking skin in the freezing saltwater hell; Repent for the sins of harming each other in the hells of wolves, iron birds, and hunting dogs; Repent for the sins of stabbing, slashing and tearing each other in hell with swords and claws; Repent for your sins and be roasted in hell; Repent for the sins that were crushed by the two rocks in hell; Repent for the sins that were plundered in hell, surrounded by mountains and rocks; Repent for the sins that were punished by being chopped up in the gloomy flesh mountain hell; Repent for the sins that were chopped off in hell, sawed and crucified; Repent for your sins and be dissected in hell with iron rods and hung upside down; Repent for the sins of unjust retribution in hell, burning with heat and screaming; Repent for your sins and endure the long, dark night without the sun, moon, and stars in the large and small spaces of Thiet Vi mountain; Repent for your sins in Abba-ba hell, A-ba-ba hell, A-tra-tra hell, and A-la-la hell. In all such cold and hot hells there are eighty-four thousand grating hells.

The sufferings include being painfully fried, skinned and stripped of flesh, bones split, marrow broken, intestines pulled out, lungs ripped out, and many other sufferings that cannot be heard or spoken. Namo Buddha! Those who are now falling into those hells, whether they were our parents or relatives in the beginningless life, we and them, after death will fall into such hells.

Today we wash our hearts clean, bow our heads towards the Buddhas and great Bodhisattvas in the ten directions, praying for repentance, causing all those sins to be destroyed.

We pray that thanks to the merit of repenting for our sins in hell, we will be able to break down the iron wall of Avici to become the Pure Land, without the name "evil path", all the pain and fear in the hells will be transformed into conditions of joy; Mountains of knives and forests of swords turn into treasure forests; The cauldron fire turns oil into lotus flowers; The buffalo-headed prison guard abandoned tyranny and developed a compassionate heart that no longer had evil thoughts. And sentient beings in the hell path escape suffering, do not cause other evil causes, enjoy peace and joy like in the Third Meditation, and at the same time develop the mind to seek the Supreme Way.

After repenting and making vows, please wholeheartedly pay homage to the Three Jewels.

Namo Tỳ Lô Giá Na Buddha.
Namo Bổn Sư Shakyamuni Buddha.
Namo Amitabha Buddha.
Namo Maitreya Buddha.
Namo Long Chủng Thượng Tôn Vương Buddha.
Namo Long Tự Tại Vương Buddha.
Namo Bảo Thắng Buddha.
Namo Giác Hoa Đinh Tự Tại Vương Buddha.
Namo Ca Sa Tràng Buddha.
Namo Sư Tử Hống Buddha.
Namo Manjushri Bodhisattva.
Namo Samantabhadra Bodhisattva.
Namo Đại Thế Chí Bodhisattva.
Namo Kshitigarbha Bodhisattva.
Namo Đại Trang Nghiêm Bodhisattva.
Namo Quán Tự Tại Bodhisattva.

Pay homage to the Buddhas and then repent. Having previously repented for the sins retribution in hell, now I repent for the retributions for the sins in the three evil realms.

In the Buddhist scriptures it is said: "Because people have many desires, many greedy for profit and gain, they also suffer a lot." People who know enough, even if they are on earth, will still be happy. People who don't know enough, even if they are in heaven, will not be satisfied. However, if people suddenly have a serious accident, they often give up all their assets, no matter how big or small. Yet without knowing that this body, when the breath does not return, must be lost. Sometimes there are intellectuals who advise us to do meritorious deeds to preserve good dharma for the next life, but instead we stubbornly stubbornly refuse to do what is right. How stupid people like that are! Why? In the Buddhist scriptures, it is said: "When you are born, you will not be able to bring a penny back, and when you die, you will not be able to take a penny to take away." People in this world have to suffer to save money, only causing more anxiety and sadness that does not help them, but others enjoy it all. There is no good fate, no merit to rely on, so much so that when we die, we must fall into the evil path. Therefore, today we sincerely bring our bodies and lives to the Three Jewels, praying for repentance.

Next, we ask for Repentance for the sins of ignorance in animals; Repent for the heavy retributions of plowing and paying for old debts in the animal world; Repent for the sins of being stabbed, sliced, pecked, cut by others, and not being free in the animal life; Repent for the sins of having no legs, two legs, four legs or many legs in animals; Repent of the sins committed in the feathers, wings, shell, scales, in the body bitten by small insects, and in animals. Among animals, there are countless retributions for such sins. Today, we sincerely ask for repentance. We ask again to repent for our sins of always suffering from hunger and thirst for hundreds of thousands of years without hearing the name of food and water among the hungry ghosts; Repent for the sins of eating, drinking, blood, pus, and dirty feces among hungry ghosts; Repenting for retributions, every time you move your body, all the details burn in the hungry ghosts. Among the hungry ghosts, there are countless such retributions, today we bow our heads and ask for repentance.

We again ask for repentance for the sins of retribution or flattery and arrogance among the Tula and ghosts; Repent for the sins of carrying sand, carrying stones to fill rivers, and protecting seas among ghosts and spirits; Repent for the sins of eating and drinking flesh and blood, and suffering all the evils of the demon gods La-sat and Cu-ban-tea. Among the demons and gods, there are boundless and boundless retributions for such sins. Today we turn to the Buddhas of the ten directions and the Bodhisattva earth to pray for repentance and cause those retributions to be destroyed.

May thanks to the merit of repenting of the sins committed in the animal path, we will forever destroy all foolishness, know our karmic conditions, be wise and wise, and not be caught in evil paths.

May thanks to the merit of repenting for the sins committed in the path of hungry ghosts, we will forever be free from suffering, deceit, hunger and thirst, and can often eat the nectar of liberation.

I pray that thanks to the merit of repenting for the sins committed in the path of Tula ghosts and gods, we will have an upright nature and stay far away from causes and wrong lives, eliminate the far-reaching retributions, and bring many benefits to all humans and heavens.

We... vow that from now on until we reach the ashram, we will no longer suffer the retributions of the four evil paths, except for great compassion to save sentient beings, with the strength of our vow to abide therein, never to be discouraged.

We have repented of the sins committed in the three evil paths. Now, in order to pray, we will repent of the sins punished in the human world.

Together we receive our lives in this world of Jambudvipa, although it is said that for a hundred years, not many people live to the fullest. During that time, the number of young people who died prematurely was unimaginable, suffering continued to torment their bodies, anxiety and fear did not stop for a moment. The reason for this is because there are very few good roots and too many bad karma, so much so that no matter what you do in this life, you are not satisfied. You should know that this is the residual effect of evil karma from past lives. Therefore, today, we ask for repentance for those immeasurable consequences in the human world from beginningless time to the present and future lives; Repent of those immeasurable consequences in the human world from beginningless time to the present and future lives; Repent for the sins that result in disaster, suffering, disability, hundreds of diseases, lack of six senses, in the human world; Repent for the sins that result in being born in the wilderness, far from everyone, always suffering from wrong views, the eight tribulations and three evils; Repenting for sins that result in many illnesses, emaciation, premature death, and unjust death in the human world; Repent for your sins and suffer because of broken friends and broken love relationships in the human world; Repent for the sins of revenge, hatred, hatred, encounter, sadness and fear, in the human world; Repent for the sins of suffering from fire, water, theft, dangerous swordsmen, terrible and weak, in the human world; Repent for the sins of being lonely, miserable, wandering, wandering around, forgetting the country, living in the human world; Repent for the sins of imprisonment, being locked up in dungeons, being beaten and tortured in the human world; Repent for the retributions that have been fabricated and slandered by public and private tongues in the human world; Repent for the sins that result in being constantly sick and bedridden, unable to stand up in the human world; DUE KINH

It is thought that in addition to the translated Sutras, Laws, and Treatises of the Holy Religion, many of the books produced by the Sages later were all created through inspiration. If we talk about each quality individually, it is not easy to list them all. Even as this text calls it Water Repentance, I would like to clearly state the reason.

In ancient times, during the reign of King Duong Y Ton, there was a national teacher named Ngo Dat, named Tri Huyen. When he was not yet enlightened, he often met a monk in Kinh Su land in a certain temple. That monk had ca-ma-la (leprosy) and no one worshiped him. Only Tri Huyen was always close and asked questions, not boring at all. When saying goodbye, the monk was so impressed by Tri Huyen's demeanor that he said:

- In the future, if you have any trouble, you should go to Cuu Lung mountain in Banh Chau, Tay Thuc land to look for me and remember that on that mountain there are two pine trees that mark the place where I live.

After that, Master Wuda came to An Quoc Pagoda, and his morality resonated even more widely. King Y Ton personally came to Dharma President to listen to him preach. Because of that, the king graciously gave him a dharma seat made of agarwood and from then on, scabies suddenly appeared on his knees like a human face, causing unspeakable pain! He invited all the famous doctors, but no one could cure him. Because he remembered what he had told him before, he went into the mountains to look for it.

On the way, the sky was already dark, in the dark clouds and smoke, he looked around, suddenly saw two pine trees, he believed that the old promise was not wrong. He immediately went to that place, and sure enough, he saw the magnificent golden palace and jade palace, with bright light shining everywhere. In front of the door, a monk was waiting to welcome him cordially.

By staying the night, Mr. Ngo Dat revealed all his suffering. That monk said:

- It's okay, there's a stream under this mountain, you can wash the scabies in the morning and it'll be gone.

Early the next morning, a young monk led him out to the stream. As soon as he poured water on it to wash it, the scabies cried out:

- Don't wash it too quickly. You are very knowledgeable and have studied ancient books. Have you ever read the story of Vien Ang and Tieu Tho written in the Western Han series?

- I read it.

- You've read it, how can you not know about Vien Ang killing Tieu Tho? How unjustly he was beheaded in the Eastern market. I have always sought to avenge you, but for ten lifetimes you have been a high-ranking monk with strict precepts, so I have not been able to take revenge. Now, because you are so loved by the king, I have begun to think about fame and fortune at the expense of morality. Only then can I take revenge on you. Now, thanks to Venerable Ca Nac Ca Venerable, he has used the samadhi dharma water to wash away my resentment. From now on, I will no longer take revenge on you.

When Mr. Ngo Dat heard about it, he was frightened and quickly grabbed water to wash off the scabies, causing pain to his bones. He died and slept for a long time before waking up. When I woke up, I couldn't see the scabies anymore. That's why he knew that the Saint's hidden secrets were unfathomable to ordinary people. He wanted to go up and bow to the monk, but when he looked back, the palace had disappeared. Therefore, he built a hermitage right there and later became a temple. In the year Chi Dao of the Song Dynasty, the title was "Chi Duc Thien Tu". There was a senior monk who wrote a memoir to record this clearly.

At that time, Mr. Ngo Dat thought about the unjust injustice of many generations, if he had not met a Saint, how could he have been cured? Because of his gratitude for that strange kindness, he recited this Dharma of Repentance for recitation tomorrow afternoon, and then spread it throughout the world.

These three volumes of repentance are the text he composed at that time.

The main meaning of this article is to use Samadhi water to wash away unjust karma, so it is named Water Repentance. Also, Ngo Dat, because he felt an allergic reaction from Venerable Ca Nac Ca, used that name to name this set of repentance texts to repay that deep gratitude.

Now I clearly tell the truth and highlight the merits of the ancestors so that those who read this set of repentance texts, or worship, or recite, will know the history of the ancestors because the cause and effect, even though many lifetimes, are not wrong.
